scope: 300-second Linux debug isolated app/descendant observation window overlapping the tail of Fruit repetitions, a retained buffering failure, paused time and recognition checks. Mixed workload, not steady playback or a matched performance comparison.
limitations: Summed RSS can double count shared pages.
Process lifetimes between polls may be missed.
Kernel storage bytes are not network bytes.
Application subtree excludes Vite, benchmark Node clients and external system services.
Per-process/thread rows retained privately; no network, DB-lock or framed IPC totals measured.
